The MUR Hotel Faro Jandía & Spa is a 4-star premium property in Morro Jable, distinguished by its striking circular architecture directly opposite the Jandía lighthouse. Just steps from Playa del Matorral, the hotel, with its 214 rooms and suites, offers the ideal base for travelers seeking a central location in Fuerteventura with direct beach access and panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean."
Experience a perfect blend of active vacation and relaxation at the MUR Faro Jandía & Spa . Our 1,000 m² wellness area offers specialized relaxation concepts, while sports enthusiasts can enjoy on-site tennis courts, a mini-golf course, and partnerships for water sports and cycling. The hotel's culinary offerings focus on authentic Mediterranean cuisine, incorporating local Fuerteventura ingredients in a modern 4-star setting.

The MUR Hotels accommodations guarantee great service, fun, and above all, relaxation. Located in the south of Fuerteventura in the Jandia area, and also in the southern portion of Gran Canaria in Playa del Inglés, our hotels are designed for unmatched rest. You will also find plenty of entertainment for families with children, couples, and groups of friends. MUR Hotel Neptuno , an Adults Only (+16) getaway in Gran Canaria that will not leave you indifferent.
Forget your worries and focus on enjoying yourself with your partner, or on your own if you are a solo traveller. The MUR Hotel Neptuno in Playa del Inglés, a 4-star accommodation, is an adults-only (+16) retreat designed for total relaxation in the heart of Playa del Inglés.
Enjoy a guaranteed rest in modern, refurbished rooms where privacy is key. The experience is completed with personalised service that takes care of every detail, a relaxing beauty centre for shared treatments and the freedom to choose the All-Inclusive option without a wristband.
Although it has an outdoor swimming pool with a slide for the most fun moments, the MUR Hotel Neptuno is designed so that couples and solo travellers can find the ideal atmosphere for their holidays.
It is the perfect starting point for exploring the iconic beaches of Gran Canaria, enjoying unique experiences and then returning to the vibrant life of Playa del Inglés.
With 166 rooms at your disposal, the only thing left to do is start creating memories. Book your retreat as a couple or solo at the best price online on the official MUR Hotels website .
